_readme: Starting figures for the Business improvement calculator. Each default has a basis: 'research' (a published source, listed under sources, that we opened), or 'assumption' (a starting point the visitor is told to change). Never add a 'research' figure without its source. Prices are read from site.config.json at build time.

moneypenny2016.name: Small Business Call Report
moneypenny2016.publisher: Moneypenny, survey of 300 UK micro businesses and call data from 10,000 businesses
moneypenny2016.note: Commissioned by a call-answering company. A third of the businesses surveyed failed to answer a test call; 69% of callers who reached voicemail left no message.

lightwork2026.name: Nearly half of agency enquiries arrive out of hours
lightwork2026.publisher: The Negotiator, reporting LightWork AI platform data
lightwork2026.note: Property sector only, July to September 2026, from one vendor's platform, sample size not published. 28% of phone calls and 49% of emails and portal enquiries arrived outside 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday.

ruler2026.name: Conversion rate by industry, 2026 benchmarks
ruler2026.publisher: Ruler Analytics, 110 million website sessions across 13 industries
ruler2026.country: Not stated (UK-based company, likely international data)
ruler2026.note: Share of website visits that become a qualified lead or sale. Overall average 5.13%.

nerdwallet2025.name: How UK business owners are prioritising time and money in 2025
nerdwallet2025.publisher: NerdWallet UK, OnePoll survey of 500 UK business owners and decision-makers
nerdwallet2025.note: June 2025. Admin and operational tasks take 7.3 hours a week, 21% of leadership time; HR and team coordination another 7.3 hours.

hbr2011.name: The Short Life of Online Sales Leads
hbr2011.publisher: Harvard Business Review, audit of 2,241 US companies
hbr2011.note: Companies that contacted a lead within an hour were nearly seven times as likely to qualify it as those that waited an hour longer, and more than 60 times as likely as those that waited a day or more. Average response time was 42 hours.

checkatrade2024.name: Does Checkatrade cost money?
checkatrade2024.note: Basic membership is £30 + VAT a month at its cheapest, without leads. Per-lead prices are only shown inside the members' area.

bark2025.name: What is a credit and how much does it cost?
bark2025.note: A credit costs £1.80 excluding VAT; the credits needed per lead vary with the job.

checkatradePlumber2026.name: How much does a plumber cost?
checkatradePlumber2026.note: Editorial averages updated June 2026, not a survey: call-out £110, fix a leak £100, repair a burst pipe £150, day rate £350.

dbt2025.name: Business population estimates for the UK and regions 2025
dbt2025.publisher: Department for Business and Trade, official statistics
dbt2025.note: 5.7 million private sector businesses; 75% have no employees; 99.85% are SMEs.

types.label: Trades and home services
types.jobValueNote: Checkatrade's guide puts repairing a burst pipe at about £150 and a plumber's day rate at £350

phoneShare.label: Share of enquiries that come by phone

missedShare.label: Share of calls that go unanswered
missedShare.note: A third of UK micro businesses failed to answer a test call

noMessageShare.label: Share of unanswered callers who leave no message
noMessageShare.note: 69% of callers who reached voicemail hung up without leaving one

outOfHoursShare.label: Share of calls that arrive outside 9 to 5
outOfHoursShare.note: 28% of phone calls to UK estate agencies; the only UK figure we found, so treat it as indicative

conversion.label: Share of enquiries that become customers
conversion.note: We found no published UK figure by industry, so this is a starting point. Use your own

visitsPerMonth.label: Visits to your website a month

adminHours.label: Hours a week you spend on admin and keeping an eye on things
adminHours.note: UK business owners spend 7.3 hours a week on admin and operations

ownerHourValue.label: What an hour of your time is worth

directorySpend.label: What you spend on lead sites and directories a month
directorySpend.note: For reference: Checkatrade's cheapest plan is £30 + VAT a month, without leads; Bark credits are £1.80 each

bands._readme: Results are shown as a likely figure with a low to high band. These shares are assumptions and are shown as such.
